$meta.rule: Never hardcode a hex in product code — reference tokens only. Values here mirror chert-tokens.css verbatim.

chert-orange.use: Primary buttons, key fills, active states. FILL ONLY on light backgrounds — never text.

chert-orange-deep.use: Button hover, underlines, icons on tinted fills. Not body text on light backgrounds.

chert-ink.use: Body text, headings, dark surfaces, footer, focus rings.

chert-success.use: Confirmations, healthy status. Status only — never decorative.

accessibility.standard: WCAG 2.1 AA — 4.5:1 body text, 3.0:1 large text and UI boundaries
mandatory-rules: Orange (#FF8651) and orange-deep (#F26B33) are fill colors, NOT text colors on light backgrounds. Orange on cream is 2.28:1; orange-deep on cream is 2.89:1 — both fail at every size.
All body text on light surfaces is chert-ink or chert-muted.
Primary button text is chert-ink on orange (7.29:1), never white (2.39:1 — fails).
On dark surfaces orange passes (7.75:1) for text and accents.
Focus rings and icon glyphs are ink — orange-deep fails the 3:1 non-text minimum on cream and orange-tint.
Never rely on color alone to convey state — pair with icon or label.
60-30-10 distribution: 60% cream/white, 30% ink/tan, 10% orange for primary actions only.
